subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: - Flight: ABC123 - Departure: 10th October 2021, 09:00 AM - Arrival: 10th October 2021, 12:00 PM Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. For any changes or inquiries, feel free to contact us. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Agency
